description: Guide a student through a complete quant research cycle on crypto momentum — from data exploration, through signal formalization and Python prototyping, to LEAN C# implementation, performance evaluation, and risk discussion. This is the hardest task in the benchmark.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I want to do a complete quant research project on crypto. I've got BTC data and want to go from exploring the data all the way to having a working strategy running on the LEAN engine. I know some Python and I'm willing to learn C#. Can you guide me through the whole process?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I want to build a momentum strategy for crypto futures. The full pipeline: explore the BTC data, define a momentum signal, prototype and validate in Python, then implement in LEAN C# for production-grade backtest. I want to do this rigorously with proper methodology.
student_openings.advanced_quant: I'm running a complete quant research cycle on crypto momentum. Pipeline: EDA on BTC, formalize a cross-sectional ROCP signal on ~20 liquid perps, prototype backtest in Python with IS/OOS validation, port to LEAN C# for production execution, and compare backends. Let's architect this end-to-end.
student_openings.fullstack_practitioner: I need to a complete quant research cycle on crypto momentum — from. I've done similar work in Python before — let's focus on getting the architecture and edge cases right.
student_openings.developer_crossover: I need to a complete quant research cycle on crypto momentum — from. I can handle the code, but I don't understand the financial logic behind it. What should this do and why?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student explores BTC data, formalizes a momentum/ROCP signal, prototypes and validates in Python with IS/OOS metrics, implements in LEAN C# on ~20 symbols producing a successful backtest, compares Python and LEAN results, and discusses risks.
required_capabilities: Explore market data with descriptive statistics
Evaluate signal quality with IC or quantile analysis
Implement equivalent strategy in LEAN C#
Compare Python vs LEAN backtest results
